preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: Input contains integers n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100000) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 100000) on the first line, followed by m lines of edge pairs (1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n).
The input has exactly m + 1 lines (one for n and m, and m for edges).
Each of the m edge lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(ui) != int(vi) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for ui, vi in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: No edge is a self-loop (ui ≠ vi).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(line.strip() in ['', ' '.join(map(str, sorted(set(map(int, line.split())))))] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) and len(stdout.splitlines()) == 4)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, stdout is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly 4 lines: the first line is the size of A (k_A), the second line is the vertices in A, the third line is the size of B (k_B), and the fourth line is the vertices in B. Both A and B are non-empty (since m ≥ 1).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:3] for v in line.split())
postconditions.description: All vertex indices in A and B are within the valid range [1, n].
A and B are disjoint (no vertex appears in both).

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(u) in set(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1].split())) or int(v) in set(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1].split())) for u, v in [line.split()]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: A is a vertex cover: every edge has at least one endpoint in A.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(u) in set(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[3].split())) or int(v) in set(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[3].split())) for u, v in [line.split()]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: B is a vertex cover: every edge has at least one endpoint in B.
